connector.name: cadloop Slicer
connector.registryDescription: Find printer profiles, check bed fit, slice to .gcode.3mf and extract the G-code.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package cadloop. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the richardofortune account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: SLICER_WORKSPACE
env.description: The only directory this server reads and writes. Defaults to ~/cad.

env.name: SLICER_BIN
env.description: Path to the slicer binary. Auto-detected if unset. Creality Print's CLI does not work headless on macOS; prefer OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio or ElegooSlicer there.

env.name: SLICER_PROFILE_DIRS
env.description: Extra profile roots, os.pathsep separated. Added to the auto-detected roots rather than replacing them.

env.name: SLICER_TIMEOUT
env.description: Seconds before a slice is killed. Defaults to 600.
